changelog:
Initial release: Seamless Google Docs API integration via Maton

- Create Google Docs, read their content, and write/append text.
- Full support for styling (paragraphs, headings, bold, etc.) and search/replace.
- Export documents as PDF, DOCX, or plain text using the Google Drive API.
- Managed OAuth; authentication flows and API key management via Maton.
- Includes Python quickstart examples for all key operations.
summary: Google Docs API integration with managed OAuth via Maton. Create documents, read full text, write/append content, search and replace, apply paragraph styles...
